latinmodern-math.woff2: Latin Modern Math (GUST e-foundry), converted from latinmodern-math.otf to WOFF2.
Source: https://www.gust.org.pl/projects/e-foundry/lm-math
License: GUST Font License (https://www.gust.org.pl/projects/e-foundry/licenses)
Used for MathML rendered by Temml in the app and in PDF exports (dsl_crud/infrastructure/markdown.py).
